title: Domain Specific Benchmarks for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing benchmarks (e.g., CultureVLM, CVLUE, TimeTravel) that evaluate model performance on non-Western data (such as Chinese cultural images and historical artifacts) compared to Western-centric datasets to identify gaps in cultural understanding and representation.
Reviewing a simulation framework (AgentReview) that models peer review processes to analyze the influence of social dynamics and reviewer bias on decision-making.

Reviewing literature and survey papers (e.g., LLM-Bias) that categorize metrics, datasets, and techniques for evaluating fairness and mitigating biases related to social media analysis and general societal demographics.
